mechanism: Benazepril (ACE inhibitor) may potentiate meprobamate's CNS depressant effects and both agents can cause hypotension, with meprobamate potentially reducing benazepril's antihypertensive efficacy through its own hypotensive properties.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, counsel patient on additive CNS depression risks, and adjust dosing if hypotension develops; consider alternative anxiolytic with lower CNS interaction potential.
